posts.author: pasha_barbashin
posts.text:
I almost left this project behind. Now 150+ people use it.

Sōka was my first web project in 2025. I built it to learn what I could make with AI as a non-developer.

It helped organise and store health test results. Mostly for my wife, me, and our nutritionist.

Then I moved on to other ideas.

Around April, organic traffic started growing. New signups came every week.

posts.author: ImZaneKelly
posts.text:
Saturday devlog on my island war game.

Before: every island was a grid of square tiles with rocks dropped on top.

After: one terrain mesh per island, grown from the match seed. Rounded beaches, proper shallows, mountains that sit in the ground.

Same seed on both sides gives the same island, so multiplayer stays in sync.

posts.author: RandomPerson242
posts.text:
AI game development: "well this is interesting."

I've long used chatgpt as my local go-to for brainstorming and chatter. I also use it for questions about some game I'm playing. "How do I..." Since chatgpt has good memory across conversations, "it knows me pretty well".

So I used chatgpt to brainstorm my latest game idea and we got to a pretty good concept for a prototype, which I fed to Claude.

Mobile studios pay thousands of dollars for a single playable ad, and this week I had an agent build one out of a Unity game I found on GitHub.
